snippet.title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials Joins Steam Next Fest!
snippet.description:
🔥 13Z's Steam Next Fest Demo is Officially LIVE on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348250/13Z_The_Zodiac_Trials/?utm_source=youtube

Grab your friends and check out 13Z's brand new playable demo this Steam Next Fest! Fight enemies, craft your strongest builds, and even roll around as a panda.

🔗 Full blog here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2348250/view/696526260588775410

📌 Wishlist 13Z on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348250/13Z_The_Zodiac_Trials/?utm_source=youtube

Join the community:
💟 Discord: https://discord.gg/AQqw9yFAHr
🐦 Twitter: https://twitter.com/13z_game
👾 TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@13z.game

🔔 Subscribe to follow development and watch new features drop as we continue building 13Z: The Zodiac Trials.

#13Z #CoopGameplay #Roguelike #ActionGame #SteamGames #indiegame #gamedev #gamedevelopment
